critical_code_review_comments: engine.wait_log correctly uses time.time() - bot.last_wait_log < 300 for throttle and inserts a single HOLD/fund/WAITING log; sets last_wait_log via set_bot so subsequent ticks respect the window — verified by the second-call-within-300s test showing no additional log.

engine.execute pre-flight: for BUY it calls free_of(ex, quote) BEFORE create_order, so zero USDT short-circuits via wait_log and NO order is placed — this directly fixes the described InsufficientFunds 51008 spam.
engine.execute SELL uses min(bot.position_qty, free BTC) and skips with WAITING if below exchange minimum — correct behaviour when a BTC deposit is still unconfirmed on OKX.
engine.execute auto_fund runs BEFORE the free-balance check, so a USDT deposit sitting on funding gets swept into trading first — good ordering.

exchange_service.friendly: f'code":"{code}"' match on flat (spaces stripped, lowercased) string correctly tolerates OKX's data-array sCode wrapper and arbitrary whitespace — the exact raw string from the problem statement maps to the 51008 message.

sync_position threshold 1e-5 BTC prevents noise/dust from flipping an empty bot into a phantom long. The 'reduce if btc < position_qty*0.5' branch is a tad coarse — a partial deposit landing between 50% and 100% would NOT update position_qty down, but that only matters for manual off-bot sells which is an acceptable gap.
sync_position sets entry_price to current SNAPSHOT price when first syncing — this is explicitly reflected in the log 'P&L counted from now', good UX.
engine.tick_bot reloads bot after refresh_live_equity (so position_qty updated by sync_position is seen by signal()) — correct ordering.

engine.execute wraps the whole order path in try/except and logs 'order error: <friendly>' with fill=REJECTED on raise; since the zero-balance guard now short-circuits before create_order, OKX 51008 will no longer reach this REJECTED path for the described user — spam gone.

rca of the issue: Original bug: engine.execute() for live BUY placed a market order every tick without checking trading-wallet quote balance first. OKX returned sCode 51008 (InsufficientFunds) and the error-mapping dict in exchange_service.friendly didn't recognise the 51008 code embedded in the ccxt data-array string, so the log just showed the raw OKX blob and this fired on every tick (seconds). Separately, BTC held on OKX (either from a prior deposit or trading-side) was not reflected in bot.position_qty so SELL signals were never emitted. Fix verified in this iteration: (a) OKX_ERRORS[51008] added + friendly() match now case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant via the flat/lowered string — exact raw payload maps to 'Not enough balance on OKX for this order. (OKX 51008)'. (b) engine.execute now, after auto_fund, queries free USDT and if below position_usd calls wait_log — which inserts a single HOLD/fund/WAITING log throttled to one per 300s and returns WITHOUT calling create_order. (c) engine.sync_position pulls BTC total across trading+funding; when flat and exchange BTC >= 1e-5 it sets position_qty and logs 'Synced position' SYNCED; when the exchange balance drops below half the recorded position it reduces/flattens the bot. (d) engine.tick_bot reloads bot after refresh_live_equity so the sync is visible to the next signal() call. All four behaviours verified by unit tests with a FakeEx so no real OKX calls are made.
